voice.hook: Your money is safe in a savings account. Or is it?
voice.setup: Say you park {amount_long} there. It earns {a_rate} a year. Feels safe.
voice.race: Prices go up about {b_rate} a year. Your money grows at {a_rate}. Watch the gap open, year after year.
voice.result: After {years} years, {lost_pct} of your buying power is simply gone.
voice.end: Safe is not the same as growing. Comment grow if this hit you.
